## Did-you-mean suggestions rank same-module symbols first (the guessed… — 2026-07-30 (parent baec8016cb2c)

**Did-you-mean suggestions now rank same-module symbols first, the CLI delegates to the shared matcher, and the version-skew warning recommends 'uv tool install --force --reinstall .'.**

`_close_qname_matches` in `mcp_server` now applies a two-pass ranking: same-module candidates are fuzzy-scored against the local name with cutoff 30 and placed first, then global qname matches (cutoff 45) fill remaining slots. This fixes the case where a query like `mod:__module__` surfaced other modules' `__module__` symbols instead of the sibling the caller intended (e.g. `trie/__init__:__version__`).

`_close_qname_suggestions` in `cli` is simplified to delegate entirely to `_close_qname_matches`, inheriting the same ranking policy rather than maintaining a duplicate rapidfuzz implementation. `cli`'s outgoing-ref count increases by one accordingly.

`_warn_on_version_skew` now recommends `uv tool install --force --reinstall .` — omitting `--reinstall` causes uv to silently reuse a cached wheel when the version number is unchanged, defeating the purpose of the warning.

### Changes

- ~ trie/cli:_close_qname_suggestions — "Fuzzy-match `qname` against all graph-known qualified names and return up to `n` close suggestions for did-you-mean hints; returns `[]` on any failure." → "Fuzzy-match `qname` against all graph-known qualified names via `_close_qname_matches` (same-module symbols ranked first) and return up to `n` suggestions;…"
- ~ trie/cli:_warn_on_version_skew — Skew warning now recommends 'uv tool install --force --reinstall .' — without --reinstall uv reuses the cached wheel when the version number is unchanged,…
- ~ trie/mcp_server:_close_qname_matches — "Fuzzy-match `qname` against candidates using rapidfuzz WRatio, returning up to `n` matches above score 45." → "Fuzzy-match `qname` against candidates using rapidfuzz WRatio, returning up to `n` close matches for "did you mean" suggestions."
